inclusive_bound: age_seconds <= max_age_seconds is FRESH; age_seconds > max_age_seconds is STALE

advisory-database.rationale: A stored advisory-DB green is not a control for today.

package-registry.rationale: Registry advisory corpora move independently of a local cache.

marketplace-index.rationale: Marketplace listings and trust scores are live.

model-vendor-availability.rationale: Model and quota availability changes inside a day.

quota-state.rationale: Quota headroom is not a stored green.

network-reachability.rationale: A last-week ping is not evidence the endpoint is up now.
